class.name: Drone Fleet Dashboard
class.description: A dashboard for monitoring and controlling a fleet of up to 5 drones simultaneously. Features include battery voltage monitoring, flight mode display, IP address configuration, and custom command buttons. (PyMAVLink version)

class.name: Drone Fleet Dashboard ROS
class.description: A ROS/MAVROS-based dashboard for monitoring and controlling a fleet of up to 6 drones simultaneously. Features include battery voltage monitoring, flight mode display, local position tracking, and fleet command buttons. Uses ROS topics for communication.

qtgui.label: Drone Fleet Dashboard (ROS)
qtgui.statustip: Monitor and control multiple drones via ROS/MAVROS
